description_en: Modify the DNS authorization rule of an instance group
description_zh: 修改实例组的DNS授权规则
kebab_example: aliyun cc5g update-group-dns-authorization-rule --wireless-cloud-connector-group-id cc5gg-0000 --authorization-rule-id ar5gg-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateGroupDnsAuthorizationRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance group
parameters.name: wireless_cloud_connector_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DNS authorization rule
parameters.name: authorization_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the DNS authorization rule.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain English letters, Chinese characters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with an uppercase or lowercase English letter or a Chinese character
parameters.help_zh:
DNS授权规则名称。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，开头必须为大小写英文字母或中文，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the DNS authorization rule.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It must start with an uppercase or lowercase English letter or a Chinese character, and it cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
DNS授权规则描述。

长度为2~256个字符，开头必须为大小写英文字母或中文，但不能为http://或https://
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The destination IP address of the DNS authorization rule
parameters.name: destination_ip

parameters.help_en:
A unique token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter across different requests. The value can contain only ASCII characters and must not exceed 64 characters.
If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run of the request. Valid values:
true: Sends a dry run request without creating the authorization rule. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether business limits are exceeded. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, the authorization rule is created immediately
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建授权规则。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建授权规则
parameters.name: dry_run
